title: Innokin Prism Apex Tank
description: Take your vaping experience to the next level with the Innokin Prism Apex Tank. Designed for optimal flavour, vapour production and-ease-of-use, this versatile tank caters to both new and experienced vapers seeking an exceptional vape. Combining exceptional flavour production with user-friendly features and a slick modern and durable design, this advanced tank is perfect for those who want a seamless and enjoyable vaping experience. The Prism Apex Tank utilizes Innokin's innovative Prism technology, which focuses on maximizing flavour. With its unique chimney design, you'll enjoy rich, intense, and satisfying taste in every puff. Say goodbye to messy refills. The Prism Apex Tank features a top fill system that makes topping up your e-liquid a breeze. Simply unscrew the top cap and pour in your favourite vape juice without any spills or leaks. Tailor your vaping experience to your preferences with the Prism Apex Tank's adjustable airflow control. Whether you prefer a tight MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw or an airier DTL (direct-to-lung) hit, you can easily fine-tune the airflow for your ideal draw. Experiment with different vaping styles using the Prism Apex Tank's broad compatibility with a multitude of Innokin Prism coil options. Choose from a range of resistances and materials to find the perfect match for your personal vaping style. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
